results.title: Become an authorized e-file provider | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: If you're a return preparer and want to e-file for clients, select Electronic Return Originator (ERO). If the Principal or Responsible Official is certified or licensed, such as an attorney, CPA or enrolled agent, they must enter their current professional status information. Individuals who do not provide this information need to be fingerprinted using the IRS authorized vendor.

results.title: E-file provider services | Internal Revenue Service
results.snippet: Software developers must access their e-Services account to submit questionnaires for each form they are testing. You must be an authorized user on a completed IRS e-file application and have principal or user granted principal consent authority or be a responsible official or delegate users with Add & Change Software Package Information authority granted.
